Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: repeatable pixel-art ground texture for a 45-degree elevated orthographic 2.5D RPG. Create a square 1024x1024 seamless edge-to-edge GROUND ONLY tile depicting frozen pale blue stone and compact snow, subtle ice cracks, frosted gravel, very sparse navy rock flecks. Match dark fantasy pixel-art palette and clustered crisp pixels, restrained detail and moderate contrast so characters/attack telegraphs are legible. No sky, horizon, perspective vanishing point, structures, vertical trees, buildings, animals, text, interface, shadows of objects, borders, or full-map composition. Surface fills whole image; evenly distributed variation; tileable edges. It will be drawn as repeated 512 logical-pixel tiles without enlarging a small background.
